plan.summary: The PR lowers the export batch size from 2000 to 500 rows. It also includes small cleanups: a variable rename, removal of a debug log, and a README typo fix.
plan.riskRationale: One constant changes the batch size. This is a small runtime change with a simple effect. The other edits are cleanups with no meaningful runtime effect, except a removed console.log.
plan.storyArc: The main change caps export batches at 500 rows. The other hunks are unrelated cleanups and do not need explanation.

noise.reason: Local variable rename only. Output is unchanged.
README typo fix. No runtime effect.

topics.title: Export batches hold at most 500 rows
topics.narrativeBrief: What does BATCH_ROWS change for export batching? Verify that batches() uses BATCH_ROWS to size its chunks.

topics.title: Remove debug logging from openMenu
topics.narrativeBrief: The console.log call in openMenu is removed. The returned menu items stay the same.
